title: Update Base Registration description in Fee Breakdown

requirements.text: In the Fee Breakdown section of the Register page, update the Base Registration description line from '₹149 × 1 member' to two lines: '₹149 × 1 member' followed by 'Includes 1 Technical & 1 Non-Technical Event'. The second line must use the same font style, text color, and alignment as the existing description text, with consistent spacing. Do not change the registration amount, fee calculation logic, Additional Event section, layout, or any other styling.

quotes: Update ONLY the Base Registration description line.
Keep same font style. Keep same text color. Keep same alignment. Maintain spacing consistency.

acceptanceCriteria: The Base Registration description shows '₹149 × 1 member' on the first line and 'Includes 1 Technical & 1 Non-Technical Event' on the second line.
The second line matches the font style, text color, and alignment of the existing description text.
Spacing between the two lines is visually consistent with surrounding content.
The Additional Event section is unchanged.
No layout or styling changes are made outside the description text.

constraints: Do not change the registration amount or fee calculation logic.
Do not modify the Additional Event section.
Do not change layout or styling beyond the description text update.
The new line must inherit the same font style, text color, and alignment as the existing description.
nonGoals: Changing any fee amounts or pricing.
Modifying the Additional Event fee section.
Altering the overall layout, color scheme, or component structure of the Register page.
